fib: ______ is any object, person, place, or concept that draws people either geographically or through remote electronic means so that they might have an experience.
attraction
An attraction is any object, person, place, or concept that draws people either geographically or through remote electronic means so that they might have an experience.
______ is a part of the tourist experience, so it can have a positive or negative effect on the impact of tourist's stay at the destination, because it depends on the tourists and their experience.
Transport at tourist destinations

Transport at tourist destinations is a part of the tourist experience, so it can have a positive or negative effect on the impact of tourist's stay at the destination, because it depends on the tourists and their experience.
______ refer to the ability of a destination to provide social, physical, and economic benefits to the population, as well as a satisfying experience for tourists.
Supply and demand
Supply and demand refer to the ability of a destination to provide social, physical, and economic benefits to the population, as well as a satisfying experience for tourists.
______ refers to how much (quantity) of a product or service is desired by buyers.
Demand
Demand refers to how much (quantity) of a product or service is desired by buyers.
______ is a strategic question in tourist cities and regions.
mobility of visitors
The mobility of visitors is a strategic question in tourist cities and regions.
______ refers to the amount of certain goods producers are willing to supply when receiving a certain price.
quantity supplied
The quantity supplied refers to the amount of certain goods producers are willing to supply when receiving a certain price.
______ is the provision of the key elements of tourism industry by the host government and destination leadership.
Tourism supply
Tourism supply is the provision of the key elements of tourism industry by the host government and destination leadership.
______ is an important aspect of choosing a destination, but will always be constrained by the budget available to the potential tourist.
Relative attractiveness
Relative attractiveness is an important aspect of choosing a destination, but will always be constrained by the budget available to the potential tourist.
______ is a major consideration determining the demand for a destination.
Cost
Cost is a major consideration determining the demand for a destination.
______ is one of the major types of tourism that requires legal mobile documents before it can be achieved by tourists.
International tourism
International tourism is one of the major types of tourism that requires legal mobile documents before it can be achieved by tourists.
______ is a necessary requirement for the development of tourism in a destination, but it is not sufficient by itself.
well-developed transport infrastructure
A well-developed transport infrastructure is a necessary requirement for the development of tourism in a destination, but it is not sufficient by itself.
______ is the time one stays at destination which can be 'day trips or overnight' and lastly for 'any travel purpose' which covers the various forms of tourism.
Thirdly
Thirdly is the time one stays at destination which can be 'day trips or overnight' and lastly for 'any travel purpose' which covers the various forms of tourism.
______ is a long-term perspective which embraces the environmental, economic and socio-cultural aspects of tourism development (WTO 2004).
Essential to sustainable tourism development
Essential to sustainable tourism development is a long-term perspective which embraces the environmental, economic and socio-cultural aspects of tourism development (WTO 2004).
______ is a broad term that covers the factors governing the level of demand, the spatial characteristics of demand, different types of demand and the motives for making such demands.
Tourism demand
Tourism demand is a broad term that covers the factors governing the level of demand, the spatial characteristics of demand, different types of demand and the motives for making such demands.
______ is a prerequisite for the development of transport, because traffic consists of a number of individual transports and that makes its infrastructure an integral part of tourist trips.
Transport infrastructure
